description: Candidate reusable Human-AI work methods under native-first requalification

interface.longDescription: A candidate skills-only portfolio of optional reusable methods around native ChatGPT. The repository is not a global router or complete provider universe. Native ChatGPT and actually available specialist providers remain primary; repo-local methods are used only when they add task-specific value. Current rebaseline dispositions are documented in skills/REGISTRY.md.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this bounded material decision when a reusable decision method adds value.
Evaluate whether this work product is fit for its intended recipient and use.
Recover and diagnose this Human-AI work system when system-development work is actually required.
capabilities: Recover and improve Human-AI work systems during rebaseline
